nodes.Name: stagingDirName
nodes.DocComment: stagingDirName is the working copy location, under the live .gen.

nodes.Name: generatedLayers
nodes.DocComment:
generatedLayers are the only directories diffed/committed. We never touch
user-imported source outside these or the .gen state.

nodes.Name: FileDiff
nodes.DocComment: FileDiff is one changed file in a staged proposal.

nodes.Name: StageResult
nodes.DocComment: StageResult is returned by Stage and re-read by Diff.

nodes.Name: StagingService
nodes.DocComment: StagingService owns the staging lifecycle. One staged proposal at a time.

nodes.Name: Pending
nodes.DocComment: Pending returns the last staged proposal, or nil.

nodes.Name: Stage
nodes.DocComment:
Stage copies the live project into a fresh staging dir, runs the evolve
plan there, and computes the diff. It does NOT modify live files.

nodes.Name: computeDiff
nodes.DocComment:
computeDiff walks the staged generated layers and compares each file to its
live counterpart.

nodes.Name: Commit
nodes.DocComment: Commit copies staged generated layers over live, snapshots, clears staging.

nodes.Name: Discard
nodes.DocComment: Discard throws away the staged proposal.

nodes.Name: lineDiff
nodes.DocComment:
lineDiff is a minimal LCS-free line diff: it emits context, - for removed,
+ for added, good enough for human review. Truncated to keep payload small.

Children.Name: for
Children.RawSource: i < len(al) && i < len(bl) && al[i] == bl[i]

Children.Name: for
Children.RawSource: ja > i && jb > i && al[ja-1] == bl[jb-1]

nodes.Name: copyTreeExcept
nodes.DocComment: copyTreeExcept copies src→dst but skips any top-level entry named `skip`.
